Actual current fill/seal and dynamic liquid painting are not exported; unsupported native state must retain native fallback at final integration.

camera: One fixed cardinal map-icon view, front of circular canteen; mild controlled cap top shading only. No object turnaround required for this fixed container entry.
native_behavior: Native liquid fill/seal/capacity and dynamic state stay authoritative. Unknown alternate painting retains native fallback at final integration.
native_acceptance: Pending full-generation gate: actual static canteen/empty exterior, source palette/coverage, liquid/seal state and native fallback. No game/harness validation during authoring.
